correctness.rationale: Automorphisms of K_(n,n) minus a perfect matching classify every three-leader set into A (all on one side), M (mixed including a removed matching pair), U (mixed not containing one). Grounded Laplacian on followers is [[(n−1)I,−C],[−C^T,(n−1)I]]. SVD gives inverse trace (q−p)/(n−1)+2(n−1)*sum_j[(n−1)^2−sigma_j²]^{-1}. Computing CC^T in each orbit yields all three claimed rational costs. Symbolic cancellation independently verified J_M−J_A=2/[n(n−2)(n−1)] and J_U−J_M=2(n−1)(2n²−9)/[3n(n−2)(3n²−8n+3)]>0 for n≥4. Independently enumerated EVERY 3-leader set on n=4,5,6 with exact SymPy inverse traces and matched class formulas; min count is 2*binom(n,3).
residual_risks: Only exactly three noise-free leaders on simple unit-weight crown graphs with n≥4.
